as_told.title: Montana truck driver and police officer see the UFO
as_told.place_text: near Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana

plain: In 1967, a truck driver passing through the town of Belt, Montana, about 35 miles from a nuclear missile site, is said to have seen a light come down into a ravine. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who says a UFO shut down ten of his nuclear missiles that year, passes on the driver's account. Michels tells it more briefly, saying a local truck driver and a police officer are both "on record having seen the UFO in the area," without mentioning the ravine. Both tell it as outside support for the strange events at the missile sites.
